flows.name: An agent runs as a durable workflow, and a person approves its decisions (Temporal)
flows.summary: Temporal's AI page, in its own terms: a developer writes the agent as a workflow in code; Temporal keeps its state, retries what fails until a model returns valid data, and pauses for a person where the workflow asks; the figures and customer names (Replit, Retool, Gorgias) are Temporal's.

steps.what: Writes the AI application or agent as a workflow in code with Temporal's SDKs, coding for the happy path only.
Calls models and tools in a loop; Temporal orchestrates the calls across models, tools and data stores.
steps.agent: Call the model and the tools it chooses.

steps.what: Holds the workflow's state over long periods (even years) and retries automatically until a probabilistic model returns valid data, so the run completes in spite of failures.
Validates the model's results or approves the agent's decisions where the workflow calls for it (human in the loop).
Inspects the run's inputs, outputs and performance in Temporal's UI and step-debugs its execution.
